body:
## Outcome

Run the still-unstarted R01 exactly once against the corrected fixed V1 gateway/DirectTarget profile, only after separate owner authorization and the current operational checks below. #81's implementation/setup obligations are complete; this completion does not authorize admission. The prior OpenAI/v4 instructions remain superseded.

## Authority and provenance

Follow #62, #81, resolved #69, the blocked/not-run #71 record, the source-backed #72 finding, `docs/governing/current.md`, and `evaluation/p5/v5/protocol.md`.

Preserve P5 v1-v4 byte-for-byte, the frozen corpus and judge, v2 claim-level decision rules, v3 operational policy, and every prior blocked/not-run record. R01 remains available because no prior task admitted or dispatched it. Issue #72 remains the dependency finding for a future node-local OAuth profile; it is not a blocker for this V1 run.

The corrected v5 freeze is `52eb3569b3671baa37426792a67b50058e2d223f`. The compatible product/dependency/test baseline is `9c799de1b5cfff16082e65531933e7a249544282`, retained in the [checksummed #81 setup record](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v5-setup/README.md) at `e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd`. The full suite passed 351 tests and 267 subtests; installed SDK/native bytes match the pinned release. Product/dependency and frozen protocol bytes are unchanged. Recheck compatibility immediately before admission; do not rerun historical campaigns or reuse the v4 driver.

[The v5 setup helper and handoff](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/e4ec8024fa6a954dda062677ea3d325b8ebd5cbd/evaluation/p5/v5/setup.md) are ready. Fresh local v5 source/store/entitled-source/Work Unit/Contract records are prepared from existing private `faviann/broodling-p5-v3-20260917`, open R01 issue #1 and `p5-eval` at frozen B1. Setup repeated identically; zero admission/Attempt/submission records exist. Keep the retained setup package immutable and use a new live-evidence directory for trial accounting/results.

Before admission, supply current nonempty `GATEWAY_API_KEY`, exact `GATEWAY_BASE_URL`, and current authorized `GH_TOKEN` ephemerally; none are present in the inspected session environment. Authenticated `gh` repository access reports push/admin permission, but the current delivery token and its scope still need checking. Start a compatible isolated DirectTarget at the recorded `http://127.0.0.1:18767` or explicitly align a new intended origin before admission; the prior container is stopped. Verify native discovery/empty run inventory, runtime compatibility, target DNS/TLS gateway reachability, operator stop access and sufficient quarantine capacity. Recheck the private repository, exact issue body, branch B1, no PRs and zero-start store/slots. Do not launch an extra provider task as preflight.

Operator endpoint verification found `/models` → 404 and `/v1/models` → 200. The corrected v5 freeze `52eb3569b3671baa37426792a67b50058e2d223f` supersedes the original root-endpoint profile in `c8d3285`. This endpoint check starts no trial and does not establish native PR delivery or task quality.

## Exact execution profile

Use only:

- Zeroshot standard `software-change` workflow;
- native `pull_request` delivery through the supported DirectTarget path;
- the Contract-authorized repository, target branch, and exact B1;
- one `UniformRuntime` across the workflow with Codex, gateway, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium reasoning effort, size `small`, and execution-scoped sessions; and
- exact `GATEWAY_BASE_URL=https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1`, current nonempty `GATEWAY_API_KEY`, and current GitHub delivery credential (`GH_TOKEN`) supplied only in the SDK environment at initial or idempotently replayed dispatch, through the #81 handoff. Do not send `OPENAI_API_KEY` or persist credential values in Contracts, requests, runtime plans, logs or evidence. Reconnect/wait/stop remain credential-free from the persisted DirectTarget origin.

The pinned Zeroshot 10.3.0 / Python SDK 10.3.0.post1 remains selected. R01-R08 remain `NOT_STARTED` until separately authorized admission; no existing setup record is live-boundary evidence.

Do not introduce node-local OAuth, variable harness/model selection, per-node runtime overrides, skills/tool capability profiles, fleet orchestration, provider substitution, or manual PR delivery.

## Work

Recreate or verify the disposable fixture and current prerequisites as needed. Then record the R01 start immediately before its first admission attempt, admit and dispatch it once through the normal Broodling to Zeroshot boundary, reconnect from durable correlation, and retain the native result, exact PR receipt/head revision, Broodling disposition, and dispatched-Attempt quarantine consequence.

Independently judge the exact receipt `headRevision` against the original frozen R01 criteria and B1. Keep native outcome, Broodling disposition, and evaluator judgment distinct. Setup failures before first admission may be corrected without consuming the slot. After admission begins, do not replace or rerun the Attempt.

Do not run R02-R08.

## Completion

Retain either compatible successful R01 boundary evidence or an honest terminal FAIL/BLOCKED record, update #62 and #68 with the result, and stop. A successful boundary may unblock #68; issue closure or setup alone does not.
title: [P5] Run still-unstarted R01 against the fixed V1 DirectTarget profile
